name: kitchen-rush
description: Static browser game, no build step. This file only declares the test tooling used by CI (see HANDOFF.md).

scripts.test:syntax: for f in *.js tests/*.mjs tools/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:fast: node tests/wording.test.mjs && node tests/pages.test.mjs && node tests/modules.test.mjs
